---
title: "Merge_Seurat"
output: html_document
date: "2025-02-06"
---

Note: Merge downsampled datasets into one.

Load libraries
```{r}
library(Seurat)
```


Load Seurat Objects
```{r}
se1 <- readRDS(file="AllNeurons/se_250_cells.RDS")
se2 <- readRDS(file="AllNonNeurons/se_250_cells.RDS")
```

Merge
```{r}
merged_seurat <- merge(se1, y = se2)
```

Check
```{r}
table(merged_seurat$supercluster_term)
```

Save
```{r}
saveRDS(merged_seurat, file = "Merged_whole_human_brain_random_250/se_250_cells.RDS")
```
